name: ai-assisted-speedruns
description: Plugin framework and open standard for AI Assisted Speedruns

scripts.check: for f in packages/core/src/*.mjs packages/core/src/windows/*.mjs packages/core/src/gui/*.mjs packages/runtime-*/*.mjs packages/recorder-*/*.mjs packages/timer-*/*.mjs games/portal/*.mjs games/portal-2/*.mjs games/balatro/*.mjs games/slay-the-spire/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.portal:run: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs run --runtime claude-code --game games/portal/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --overlay-port 8765 --run-dir
scripts.portal:doctor: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs doctor --game games/portal/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --runtime claude-code
scripts.portal:scripted: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs run --runtime scripted --game games/portal/plugin.mjs --bot games/portal/bot.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --overlay-port 8765 --run-dir
scripts.portal2:doctor: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs doctor --game games/portal-2/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --runtime claude-code
scripts.sts:doctor: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs doctor --game games/slay-the-spire/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --runtime claude-code
scripts.sts:scripted: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs run --runtime scripted --game games/slay-the-spire/plugin.mjs --bot games/slay-the-spire/bot.mjs --recorder null --run-dir
scripts.sts:run: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs run --runtime claude-code --game games/slay-the-spire/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --overlay-port 8765 --run-dir
scripts.balatro:doctor: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs doctor --game games/balatro/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --runtime claude-code
scripts.balatro:scripted: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs run --runtime scripted --game games/balatro/plugin.mjs --bot games/balatro/bot.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --overlay-port 8765 --run-dir
scripts.balatro:run: node packages/core/src/cli.mjs run --runtime claude-code --game games/balatro/plugin.mjs --recorder obs --timer livesplit --overlay-port 8765 --run-dir
